title: Swap two boxes
prompt:
Ms. Gridlock filled the bins the wrong way round. The box named `left` holds `"springs"` and the box named `right` holds `"gears"`. Swap them, without typing either word again.

When it works, `python3 swap.py` prints `left: gears` and then `right: springs`.
hints: If you write `left = right` first, what is in `left` now? Is the word springs still anywhere?
Before you overwrite `left`, copy its value into a third box, for example `spare = left`.
Three lines do it: `spare = left`, then `left = right`, then `right = spare`.
explain_after: An assignment makes a name refer to a value [py-043]. After `left = right`, the name `left` refers to `"gears"`, and nothing refers to `"springs"` any more. The third box keeps hold of `"springs"` while `left` changes.
